items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Elliott and I were very close friends

ctx.x: They say, "The tenor player with Louie" -- they didn't know who (inaudible). He say, "Well, you know, what's the tenor player with Louie Armstrong?"
So Shapiro-Bernstein thought -- well Elliott and I were very close friends, another big publishing company.
He called me and say, "I think your picture -- Glenn Miller did you song."
